about: NASA Image and Video Library (images.nasa.gov): search NASA's public image, video and audio archive, browse albums and the popular/recent feeds, and get asset files, technical metadata and video captions for any item.

commands.summary: Search NASA images, videos and audio by free text, keyword tags, NASA center, media type and year range (paged, 100 per page by default)

params.name: media_type
params.description: Comma-separated media types to include: image, video, audio (e.g. 'image,video')

params.name: keywords
params.description: Keyword tag(s) to match, comma-separated (e.g. 'LUNAR SURFACE')

params.name: center
params.description: NASA center code that published the media, e.g. HQ, KSC, JSC, GSFC, JPL, LRC, MSFC, ARC

params.name: title
params.description: Match terms in the title only

params.name: description
params.description: Match terms in the description only

commands.summary: List the downloadable file URLs (original, large, medium, small, thumb; video encodings, captions, metadata) for a NASA media item
Get the full technical and descriptive metadata (EXIF/QuickTime/AVAIL fields: dates, dimensions, duration, keywords, credits) of a NASA media item
Resolve the URL of a media item's metadata.json via the official API (use when you don't know the item's media type)
Get the SRT caption/subtitle transcript of a NASA video

params.name: nasa_id
params.description: NASA video ID (the caption file is named after it)

commands.summary: List the media items in a named NASA album (e.g. Apollo), paged

params.name: album_name
params.description: Album name as it appears in /album/{name} URLs; case-sensitive

commands.summary: List currently trending/popular media items shown on the home page
List the newest uploads to the NASA Image and Video Library
